# VC-PW-5320

The order is not frozen.
The slot uses the SDR-480 housing so the reserved space is a real supply, not a box.

Manufacturer: MEAN WELL Enterprises Co., Ltd.
Source file: `SDR-480.stp` from
https://www.meanwell.com/upload/pdf/SDR-480/SDR-480-3D.zip
The STEP file is 5.5 MB.
The file in this folder is that manufacturer file.

`Rot(0, 0, -90)` maps the file onto the plate.
Local X is the rail width, 85.5 mm.
Local Y is the depth, 129.2 mm. The curved terminal cover is at positive Y.
Local Z is the height, 125.2 mm. The vent grid is on the top face.
The rating of VC-PW-5320 stays open.
Do not treat this file as a purchase order for SDR-480-24.
